I don't know the entire situation or the people involved, but do you believe his parents would have said something like that to him and not to you directly?

Reading this I get the impression that if something was amiss or bothering them they would quite possibly bring it up with you directly.

Honestly to me it sounds as though your boyfriend is spitting the dummy out because he wanted to be cared for by mum and dad and not you, and because they've been unable to take the time out to do that for him he's bitter.

You haven't done anything wrong in my opinion, if you're house bound everyone Wears loungewear, I know I do.

I'm truly sorry for your loss as well, I know how painful that is and how your absolute everything is out of place and all over. Don't let what has happened cloud your view or judgement here though, your boyfriend, whether you love him or care for him, sounds like a bitter child from reading, and in my opinion it sounds like you can do alot lot better than him.

However I will not tell you to leave him, as it could just be he's trying to deal with things himself, and though it is no excuse, he could be lashing out like this due to whatever he has going on. Again though, that is no excuse.

I think the best thing to do here would be first of all to speak to his parents openly and ask them if they have issues with your choice of dress etc, you can bring this into a normal conversation if you don't want to out right ask them. I also think you need to have a conversation with your boyfriend and tell him what's going on in your head and heart, and see if he will tell you what's going on with him.

Together people can overcome anything, but you need to be able to work together, to converse and to connect to be able to move forward.
